items.exampleEn: It is hard to meditate in a noisy room.
items.exampleZh: 在吵鬧的房間裡很難冥想。

items.exampleEn: The fans waved excitedly when the singer came out.
items.exampleZh: 歌手一走出來，歌迷們就興奮地揮手。

items.exampleEn: The dazzle of the city lights surprised the visitors from the village.
items.exampleZh: 城市燈光的耀眼讓從村子來的訪客很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: She screamed in fright when she saw the spider.
items.exampleZh: 她看到蜘蛛時嚇得尖叫。

items.exampleEn: He was sorry for his hasty words.
items.exampleZh: 他為自己草率的話感到抱歉。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor's little girl is adorable.
items.exampleZh: 我鄰居的小女兒好可愛。

items.exampleEn: In his eagerness to win, he started running too early.
items.exampleZh: 他太想贏了，結果太早起跑。

items.exampleEn: A good doctor must be trustworthy.

items.audioEn: I need someone trustworthy to keep my house key while I'm away.
items.audioZh: 我出門時需要一個值得信賴的人幫我保管家裡的鑰匙。
items.questionZh: 說話者需要什麼樣的人？

items.sentenceEn: At the end of the class, we meditated in silence.
items.sentenceZh: 課程最後，我們靜靜地冥想。

items.sentenceEn: The loud noise gave me a fright.
items.sentenceZh: 那聲巨響把我嚇了一跳。

items.stemEn: She was in a hurry, so she wrote a ____ note and left it on the table.
items.stemZh: 她趕時間，所以匆匆寫了張字條放在桌上。

items.stemEn: The kids ran ____ to open their birthday presents.
items.stemZh: 孩子們興奮地跑去拆生日禮物。

items.passageEn: Last month, my family decided to adopt a puppy. On the way to the animal shelter, my little brother talked excitedly in the car. The staff said they only give pets to trustworthy families, so they asked us many questions. We didn't want to make a hasty choice, so we looked at every dog. Then we saw an adorable brown puppy. When my brother tried to touch it, it jumped up and gave him a fright! But they soon became friends. When we went outside, the dazzle of the sun made the puppy close its eyes. My brother's eagerness to take care of the puppy surprised my parents. Now the puppy is a faithful friend, and it sits quietly next to my mom when she meditates.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們家決定領養一隻小狗。去動物收容所的路上，我弟弟在車上興奮地說個不停。工作人員說他們只把寵物交給值得信賴的家庭，所以問了我們很多問題。我們不想做草率的決定，所以把每隻狗都看了一遍。接著我們看到一隻好可愛的棕色小狗。弟弟想摸牠時，牠突然跳起來，把弟弟嚇了一跳！但他們很快就成了朋友。我們走到外面時，耀眼的陽光讓小狗閉上了眼睛。弟弟照顧小狗的熱切讓爸媽很驚訝。現在小狗是忠實的好朋友，媽媽冥想時，牠都會安靜地坐在她身邊。

questions.questionZh: 工作人員為什麼問他們很多問題？
options: 想知道他們家附近有沒有大公園可以散步
只把寵物交給值得信賴的家庭

questions.questionZh: 弟弟想摸小狗時發生了什麼事？
options: 小狗咬了弟弟的手，還一直叫個不停
小狗跳起來，把弟弟嚇了一跳

items.promptZh: 他是一個非常值得信賴的人。
referenceEn: He is a very trustworthy person.
rubricZh: trustworthy 表示「值得信賴的」，例如 a trustworthy friend 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 我姊姊每天早上冥想十分鐘。
referenceEn: My sister meditates for ten minutes every morning.
Every morning, my older sister meditates for ten minutes.
